sample_transformerxl_text: generate unconditional text samples from a TransformerXL model using TransformerXLSampler
sample_bow2text_conditioned: generate text samples conditioned on a bag-of-words vector using Bow2TextTransformerSampler
sample_graph2text_conditioned: generate text samples conditioned on graph structures using Graph2TextTransformerSampler
create_base_sampler_subclass: create a new sampler subclass by extending BaseSampler and implementing _sample and sample methods
configure_sampler_temperature: configure a sampler with a custom temperature and device for controlled text generation
